claims: Over 800 cybersecurity skills (on screen: 818 'production-grade') for Claude or ChatGPT, free
Covers cloud and network security, malware and threat hunting, honey-token schemes
Installing them 'turns Claude or ChatGPT into the world's expert on cyber security'
Creator: Stanford founder of an AI startup that raised $4M
Category counts on screen: Network Security 43 (IDS/IPS, firewall rules, VLAN segmentation, traffic analysis); Threat Hunting 58 (hypothesis-driven hunts, LOTL detection, EVTX hunting, fleet hunting)
how_to_steps: Go to the GitHub repo mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
Copy the repo link, paste it into Claude or ChatGPT and ask it to help you install the skills
Use the installed skills to review/protect your website, app, or family devices
on_screen_only: Table rows: 'Network Security | 43 | IDS/IPS - firewall rules - VLAN segmentation - traffic analysis'; 'Threat Hunting | 58 | Hypothesis-driven hunts - LOTL detection - EVTX hunting - fleet hunting'
cta: Save the video; follow for more on AI, founder life and leadership

relevance.why: A security-skill library could help audit our apps' auth, secrets and deployment, but 818 skills is a bloated catalog mostly aimed at SOC/enterprise work (EVTX, VLANs), not a solo founder's SaaS. The 'Anthropic' name is misleading.

implement_score.why: Maybe cherry-pick 3-5 skills (web app security review, secrets scanning, cloud IAM hardening) into our skills dir after reading them. Loading all 818 would pollute context and skill selection. An hour to triage; low priority versus a focused security-review skill we already have.

verify: Repo author mukul975 -- who are they; is this official or an unaffiliated repo trading on the Anthropic name?
Are the 818 skills real, tested SKILL.md content or auto-generated boilerplate? Check a few in depth
Does the 'install into ChatGPT' path actually work (ChatGPT has no skills folder concept)?
